description: Drain the Implement queue through dispatch outcomes in team mode.

Run `skl implement next --mode team --dispatch --wait --worker-model '$1' --worker-thinking '$2' --helper-model '$3' --helper-thinking '$4' --reviewer-model '$5' --reviewer-thinking '$6'` and follow each Outcome Instruction until one tells you to stop.
